decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing is a durable core component of a drainage specialist's range with long product life cycles, and it had its own page in both years.
Floor-level shower drainage is a growing core segment, and the product moved up to its own page in 2019.
Designer shower products face shifting trends and it dropped from its own page to a mention in 2019, but it still fits the core range and is likely refreshed rather than removed.
A shower element with integrated slope complements the floor-level drainage systems and supports system sales despite having only modest visibility.
The backflow-protected basement drain was featured on the home page and addresses rising flood-protection demand.
An air-admittance valve is a low-cost standard accessory that rounds out the drainage portfolio and is cheap to keep.
